verdict.rationale: Porkbun offers a marketplace for expired-domain closeouts (fixed descending price) and standard availability/pricing search across TLDs, but there is no evidence of premium/aftermarket pricing shown inline in search results nor a broker path for currently-taken/non-expired domains held by other owners. missing for 10: premium pricing surfaced directly in domain search results, and a broker/make-offer path for taken (non-expired) domains still owned by third parties.
